messages:
Alex H: Hey infra — can we get a focused Grafana dashboard that correlates GPU thermals, power draw, and performance degradation for eu-west? We're seeing intermittent throttling on a small subset of nodes and want something to triage quickly.

Priya S: +1. We should use DCGM / nvidia-exporter metrics: dcgm_gpu_temp, dcgm_gpu_power_draw_watts, dcgm_gpu_utilization, dcgm_memory_used_bytes. Also include node inlet temps if IPMI is available.

Jamal R: Also include a throttling metric (dcgm_gpu_throttle_reasons_total or nvidia_gpu_throttle_count_total) and the NVML sample window. A heatmap per-rack would help spot hot racks vs isolated GPUs.

Keiko M: Panel suggestions: 1) Per-GPU multi-series (temp/power/util) with a 1m and 5m rollup toggle. 2) Rack heatmap (avg temp) with rack label. 3) 95th percentile power by instance_type (for capacity planning). 4) Throttle-rate histogram + list of top offenders. 5) Cost overlay: estimated $/hr for peak power draw.

Alex H: For alerts, can we tune these: temp > 85C for >5m, sustained throttle rate increase > 0.5/hr, and power draw spike (> 150W delta in 5m)? We want quiet alerts but still catch degradation before user-facing latency increases.

Priya S: Draft PromQL snippets (feel free to adapt):

```
# avg GPU temp over 5m per gpu
avg_over_time(dcgm_gpu_temp_celsius{region="eu-west"}[5m])
\n# 95th percentile power over 1h (using recording rule would be better)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(dcgm_gpu_power_watts_bucket[1h])) by (le, gpu_model))
\n# throttle increase in last 1h
increase(dcgm_gpu_throttle_total[1h]) > 0
\n# sudden power delta (approx)
(delta(dcgm_gpu_power_draw_watts[5m])) > 150
```

Keiko M: I'll add recording rules for hourly/5m aggregates so dashboards are snappy. Suggest recording: gpu:temp:avg_5m, gpu:power:95p_1h, gpu:throttle:rate_1h.

Jamal R: Also add endpoint panels for per-pod or per-VM breakdown so SREs can correlate with workloads. Use the pod label if exporter is annotated with k8s metadata.

Alex H: Good point — we should have a template variable for cluster, rack, GPU model, and workload tag.

Priya S: Small nit on alerts: escalate to paging only for sustained throttles that correlate with latency SLO breaches. Otherwise just slack notif to #eng-infra.

Keiko M: I'll prototype and post a draft JSON. Assigning to @Keiko M to make a draft dashboard and PR to infra-monitoring. ETA EOD tomorrow.

grafana-bot: Draft dashboard created: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/gpu-cooling-power-proto (draft).

Alex H: Perfect — add a quick runbook link to the dashboard (how to check IPMI, swap fans, or migrate pods). Also include a cost metric: watts * $/kWh approximate.

Priya S: I'll add recommended alert thresholds to the dashboard notes and a small table mapping GPU models -> safe operating temp.

Jamal R: :thumbsup: Let me know if you want me to tweak SLO correlation panels (I have a couple of PromQL suggestions for p99 latency joins).

Keiko M: Will do. Creating PR now -> #infra-monitoring.

Alex H: Thanks everyone — this will save a lot of time during next incident.
